answer: One operator wearing ten thousand masks leaves one set of habits: identical latency fingerprints, the same silent hours, the same error retries — a farm's voices are one voice echoing around a lagoon. Log each identity's transaction timing and behavior, then each epoch run pairwise correlation and merge overly correlated identities into one operator cluster splitting a single reward instead of ten. Evasion means faking independent lives — separate hardware, schedules, operators — costing nearly as much as real agents, and the stolen lantern only ever lit the one thief carrying it.
